sentences.text: Heard with the aid of case diary.

This is second application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicants/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.165/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Maheshwar, District Khargone (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 363, 366A,376, 376(2)(n), 376(3), 368, 506, 34 of IPC and under Sections 3/4 read with Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2. His first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 10.06.2024, passed in M.Cr.C. No.21172/2024 with liberty to renew the prayer after two months.
3. Prosecution story, in brief is that in the intervening night of 6th and 7th of April 2024, when the p r o s e c u t r i x w a s s l e e p i n g a t h e r m a t e r n a l u n c l e ' s N E U T R A L C I T A T I O N N O .
2024

: MPHC-IND:26474 2 MCRC-37958-2024 house, at around 1.00 a.m., co-accused Dipak came there and on false pretext to marry her, he took the prosecurix to the present applicant's house where the present applicant confined the prosecutrix and co-accused Dipak in a room.

Thereafter,
co-accused Dipak committed rape upon the prosecutrix repeatedly.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.
As alleged, the main accused of the incident is co-accused Dipak and the present applicant provided shelter to them.

It is also submitted that after dismissal of the first bail application of the applicant as withdrawn, the Prosecutrix(PW1) has been examined before the trial Court, but she has completely turned hostile and has not supported the prosecution case.
It is also submitted that the applicant is in custody since 08.04.2024.
After completion of investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for its rejection.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant - Sanjay S/o Malsingh Bhil shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:26474 3 MCRC-37958-2024 (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.
It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of trial but in case of bail jump, it shall become ineffective.
9. With the aforesaid, this application is allowed and stands disposed of.
Certified copy, as per Rules.
